summary: Connect a clean dataset, baseline, fitted pipeline and held-out error analysis into one reproducible study.
outcomes: Train and evaluate a complete fitted pipeline
Use error slices to propose a testable improvement
sequence: Write a dataset and split contract
Fit preprocessing and a simple model
Compare a stronger model under the same protocol
Freeze the test result and report limitations

visual.question: Which failures are hidden by one average metric?
visual.interaction: Filter errors by feature ranges without retraining on test outcomes

practice.task: Deliver a reproducible small tabular modelling report
practice.success: One command reproduces the pipeline, baseline comparison and documented error slices
